items.title_en: US Resumes Strikes on Iran as Ballistic Missile Retaliation Hits Bases Across the Region
items.summary_en: American forces resumed strikes against Iran on Tuesday after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps attempted attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, US Central Command said. Iranian state media reported that four people, including a four-year-old child, were killed and more than 50 injured when shrapnel from a US missile attack hit a home where a wedding celebration was taking place in Sirik in southern Iran. Tehran quickly retaliated, launching a barrage of ballistic missiles at a US Marine base in Aqaba, Jordan, with attacks also reported near US military facilities in Iraq, Kuwait and Bahrain. Jordan's armed forces said they intercepted 13 ballistic missiles, destroying 10 of them, while three fell in remote areas, causing no deaths or injuries. President Donald Trump warned that Iran would be hit again at "a much harder and higher level", saying a much larger-scale attack was waiting in the wings. The escalation comes after the expiry of a June memorandum of understanding that had extended a ceasefire between the two countries, with both sides also trading fire over shipping through the strategic strait.
items.title_zh: 美軍恢復空襲伊朗　伊朗以彈道飛彈報復約旦伊拉克等美军相關設施
items.summary_zh: 美國中央司令部表示，在伊斯蘭革命衛隊試圖攻擊荷莫茲海峽的商業船運後，美軍於週二恢復對伊朗的攻擊。伊朗官媒報導，美軍飛彈攻擊的彈片擊中南部錫里克一處正在舉行婚禮的民宅，造成四人死亡、超過五十人受傷，死者中包括一名四歲女童。德黑蘭迅速報復，向約旦亞喀巴的一處美國海軍陸戰隊基地發射一波彈道飛彈，伊拉克、科威特和巴林境內與美軍相關的設施也傳出遭襲。約旦武裝部隊表示，已攔截十三枚彈道飛彈，摧毀其中十枚，另外三枚落入偏遠地區，未造成人員傷亡。川普總統警告，伊朗將再度遭到「更狠、更高層級」的打擊，並說更大規模的攻擊正幕後待發。這輪升級發生在六月簽署、用以延長雙方停火的諒解備忘錄到期之後，兩邊同時仍在這條戰略海峽的航運問題上交火不斷。

items.title_en: Huawei Urges Chinese Firms to Shun Nvidia Chips in Blow to US Chipmaker
items.summary_en: Chinese technology giant Huawei has urged companies in China to use domestic alternatives to Nvidia's AI chips, a fresh blow to the US chipmaker's bid to win back the Chinese market. Speaking at a conference in Shanghai on Saturday, senior vice-president Xu Zhijun said Chinese companies should use domestic options rather than rely on foreign suppliers. The remarks show how US export controls have pushed Beijing to champion homegrown silicon, even as Nvidia lobbies Washington for licences to sell its most powerful AI chips in China. Cut off from American technology by sanctions, Huawei has made its Ascend processors the centrepiece of China's drive for AI self-sufficiency, and plans to triple spending on the chips. The company points to progress at home, noting its Kirin chips are now made on domestic five-nanometre lines and cloud revenue grew more than 30 per cent in the first half of 2026. The stakes remain high: Washington said in December that Nvidia's H200 chips would soon be allowed into China in exchange for a share of sales revenue, while chief executive Jensen Huang said in an online post that the company welcomes healthy competition from local rivals.
items.title_zh: 華為籲中國企業改用國產晶片替代輝達　美晶片廠重返中國再生變數
items.summary_zh: 中國科技巨頭華為呼籲中國企業改用輝達AI晶片的國產替代方案，對這家美國晶片廠商重奪中國市場的努力構成新的打擊。華為高級副總裁徐直軍週六在上海一場會議上表示，中國企業應該採用國產選項，而不是依賴外國供應商。這番言論凸顯美國出口管制已推動北京大力扶植自研晶片；與此同時，輝達則持續向華盛頓遊說，爭取向中國銷售其最強大AI晶片的許可。在美方制裁下無法取得美國技術的華為，已將自家昇騰處理器打造為中國追求AI自主的核心，並計畫將相關支出提高至原本的三倍。該公司提及本土進展，指出麒麟晶片如今已能在國產五奈米產線上生產，且雲端部門在2026年上半年營收成長超過三成。雙方的賭注都不小：華盛頓去年十二月表示，輝達的H200晶片將很快獲准銷往中國，但需分讓一部分銷售收入；執行長黃仁勳則在網路發文表示，公司歡迎來自本土對手的良性競爭。

items.title_en: Arsenal Owner Stan Kroenke Buys LA Angels in Reported $4bn Deal
items.summary_en: Arsenal owner Stan Kroenke has bought Major League Baseball franchise the Los Angeles Angels in a deal reportedly worth $4bn. The 79-year-old, who has held a controlling stake in the Gunners since 2011, now controls teams in six major sporting leagues, among them NFL side the Los Angeles Rams, NBA club the Denver Nuggets, NHL team the Colorado Avalanche and MLS side the Colorado Rapids. Although the price was not officially announced, the Los Angeles Times reported that it is a record sum for an MLB team, exceeding the $3.9bn the San Diego Padres fetched in August. Previous owner Arte Moreno, who bought the Angels in 2003, had faced mounting pressure from fans to sell after 11 seasons without a play-off appearance. With less than a month of the regular season remaining, the drought - the longest active in MLB - is set to reach 12 seasons, amid viral Tarps Off protests and sell-the-team chants at Angel Stadium. Moreno said his family had been honoured to steward the franchise for 23 years and endorsed Kroenke Sports & Entertainment as the best next owner for the franchise.
items.title_zh: 阿仙奴老闆克倫克傳以40億美元買下洛杉磯天使　創MLB紀錄
items.summary_zh: 阿仙奴老闆斯坦·克倫克傳出以四十億美元買下美國職棒大聯盟球隊洛杉磯天使。這位七十九歲的老闆自2011年起握有阿仙奴的控制性股權，如今旗下球隊橫跨六大職業運動聯盟，包括NFL洛杉磯公羊、NBA丹佛金塊、NHL科羅拉多雪崩與MLS科羅拉多急流。雖然成交價未正式公布，《洛杉磯時報》報導這已是MLB球隊的紀錄價格，超過聖地牙哥教士八月成交的39億美元。前任老闆阿爾特·莫雷諾於2003年買下天使隊，因球隊連續11年無緣季後賽，長期承受球迷要求出售的壓力。例行賽剩下不到一個月，這段MLB現存最久的季後賽荒將延續至第12年；期間天使主場爆發「脫衣抗議」影片瘋傳，球迷不斷高喊「把球隊賣掉」。莫雷諾表示，家族23年來以擔任天使隊的管理者為榮，並推崇克倫克體育與娛樂集團是球隊最好的下任老闆。
